title: Stable blow-up on a sphere for a quadratic-derivative nonlinear wave equation
summary: We study finite-time blow-up for the nonlinear wave equation \begin{equation*} v_{tt}-Δv=|\nabla_x v|^2 \end{equation*} in dimensions $n\geq2$, under radial symmetry. For every prescribed radius $r_0>0$, we construct solutions which blow up in finite time $T>0$ on the sphere $\{|x|=r_0\}$ with logarithmic Type-I rate. The leading singular dynamics are governed by ``generalised self-similar'' profiles of the associated one-dimensional equation, while the radial geometry generates a curvature correction of size $\mathcal{O}((\frac{T}{r_0})^2)$.
